---
title: "Monorepo Strategies with Nix"
---

# Monorepo Strategies with Nix

A monorepo with `src = ./.;` on every package rebuilds the world per commit. The boring default is: **one flake, many `packages.*`, `lib.fileset` / `cleanSourceWith` per leaf, and CI that builds `.#checks` not `.#everything` on a docs-only PR**.

## Mental model

| Layout | Nix |
|---|---|
| `apps/desk-api` | `packages.desk-api` with `src` filtered to that tree |
| `apps/desk-web` | sibling package; docs change does not rebuild api |
| `modules/` | `nixosModules` |
| `flake.nix` | one lock, nixpkgs 26.05 |

`nix flake check` should be cheap enough to run on every PR. Heavy images are extra jobs.

## Worked examples

### Case 1: fileset src

```nix
# desk-api.nix
{ pkgs, lib }:

pkgs.buildGoModule {
  pname = "desk-api";
  version = "1.0.0";
  src = lib.fileset.toSource {
    root = ../.;
    fileset = lib.fileset.unions [
      ../apps/desk-api
      ../go.mod
      ../go.sum
    ];
  };
  vendorHash = "sha256-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA=";
}
```

### Case 2: flake outputs

```nix
# flake.nix
{
  inputs.nixpkgs.url = "github:NixOS/nixpkgs/nixos-26.05";
  outputs = { self, nixpkgs }:
    let
      pkgs = nixpkgs.legacyPackages.x86_64-linux;
    in
    {
      packages.x86_64-linux.desk-api = pkgs.callPackage ./desk-api.nix { };
      packages.x86_64-linux.desk-web = pkgs.callPackage ./desk-web.nix { };
      checks.x86_64-linux.api = self.packages.x86_64-linux.desk-api;
    };
}
```

### Case 3: PR path filter (CI)

```yaml
# not Nix — workflow paths:
#  apps/desk-api/**  →  nix build .#desk-api
#  apps/desk-web/**  →  nix build .#desk-web
#  flake.lock        →  nix flake check
```

Nix will still cache; the filter saves eval time on huge repos.

### Case 4: `linkFarm` for a smoke set

```nix
pkgs.linkFarm "desk-smoke" [
  { name = "api"; path = self.packages.x86_64-linux.desk-api; }
  { name = "web"; path = self.packages.x86_64-linux.desk-web; }
]
```

Nightly builds the farm. PRs build the leaf.

### Case 5: Do not use recursive flakes

`inputs.foo.url = "path:./apps/foo"` recursive flakes multiply locks. One lock at the root.

## The trap

The trap is **`src = ./.;`** at repo root for every `callPackage`. A README typo rebuilds Go. Filter.

## The boring rule

- One flake, one 26.05 lock.
- Per-package `src` filters.
- Leaf builds on leaf PRs; `flake.lock` PRs run full check.
- No recursive flakes.
- `vendorHash` / cargo hashes per package.

## Try this

1. `nix build .#desk-api` then touch a web-only file; `--dry-run` the api (should be empty if filtered).
2. `lib.fileset` vs `cleanSource` — pick one style per repo.
3. Add a `checks` attr that is `linkFarm` of two packages.
4. Time `nix flake show` on the monorepo; if it is minutes, you eval too much at the top.
